evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We present String, an open-source runtime that gives this user an interface of its own and treats the job as an operating-systems problem.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Views stay partial by design, and the staging is causal: disclosing one tier of detail a single turn too early costs up to 23 accuracy points, while proper staging drops wrong-action selection from 28% to 2%.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On an 87-task benchmark that pairs each task with curated skills, operationalizing those procedures as on-demand String apps yields comparable aggregate success across six models from frontier to small (+1.3pp) while using 33.5% fewer tokens among completed episodes, and the resident interface stays a constant 53 tokens at any catalog size.
